  "check_code": "from pathlib import Path\nimport sqlite3\n\n\ndef check_source_anchors_present(ws):\n    workspace = Path(ws)\n    system_root = workspace.parent / \"system\"\n    clearwater = system_root / \"clearwater_ga_accounting\" / \"state.db\"\n    aladdin = system_root / \"aladdin_ga_risk\" / \"state.db\"\n    deck = workspace / \"03_Investment_Committee\" / \"MetLife_Investment_Committee_2025-10-15.pptx\"\n    if not clearwater.exists() or not aladdin.exists() or not deck.exists():\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"A required Clearwater database, Aladdin database, or committee presentation is missing\"}\n\n    with sqlite3.connect(clearwater) as connection:\n        amounts = connection.execute(\n            \"SELECT SUM(estimated_fair_value_usd_thousands), \"\n            \"SUM(CASE WHEN asset_allocation_bucket = 'Structured products' \"\n            \"THEN estimated_fair_value_usd_thousands ELSE 0 END) \"\n            \"FROM position_snapshot WHERE portfolio_id = ? AND as_of_date = ? \"\n            \"AND record_status = 'ACTIVE' AND include_in_ga_aum = 1\",\n            (\"PORT_MET_GA\", \"2025-09-30\"),\n        ).fetchone()\n\n    with sqlite3.connect(aladdin) as connection:\n        control = connection.execute(\n            \"SELECT o.observed_value_stored, o.variance_stored, o.run_status, \"\n            \"r.threshold_high_stored, r.is_applicable \"\n            \"FROM metric_observation_detail o JOIN limit_rule r ON r.rule_id = o.rule_id \"\n            \"WHERE o.portfolio_id = ? AND o.as_of_date = ? \"\n            \"AND r.metric_code = 'STRUCTURED_PRODUCTS_MAX'\",\n            (\"PORT_MET_GA\", \"2025-09-30\"),\n        ).fetchone()\n        legacy = connection.execute(\n            \"SELECT threshold_high_stored, is_applicable FROM limit_rule \"\n            \"WHERE mandate_id = ? AND metric_code = 'STRUCTURED_PRODUCTS_LEGACY_MAX'\",\n            (\"MND-METGA-2025Q3-01\",),\n        ).fetchone()\n\n    if amounts != (421763000, 63686213):\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"Clearwater source anchors differ from the expected month-end population: {amounts}\"}\n    if control != (1510, 35, \"OFFICIAL\", 1475, 1):\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"Aladdin official structured-products control anchor is incorrect: {control}\"}\n    if legacy != (1600, 0):\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"Aladdin historical-rule anchor is incorrect: {legacy}\"}\n    return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"Clearwater totals, Aladdin official control, historical-rule trap, and committee deck are present\"}\n",
